claims.evidence: Witness photos show a countertop kitchen-style appliance with a clear plastic bowl/cover on top and a brand label reading “EQUATOR 2”, not a hair dryer shape.

risks.risk: Wrong item / misrepresentation risk (seller claims hair dryer but photos show a different countertop appliance).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the appliance in use and the exact model/label plate, plus a close-up of the front controls and any attachments.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-matching/misrepresented item (worst-case: buyer may not get the expected hair dryer), so treat as lowest-value used kitchen appliance until confirmed.

risks.risk: Unverified working condition (cannot confirm it powers on, runs, or has stable speed).
risks.proof: One clip of it plugged in and running for at least 30–60 seconds, showing airflow/rotation and any speed control response.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / possibly non-working.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged accessories/attachments (a handle/attachment is visible, but completeness is unknown).
risks.proof: Photo/clip laid out of every included part (all attachments, blades, lids, cups/jars, manuals) with a count.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete set (worst-case: only the main unit with one attachment).

risks.risk: Clear bowl/cover condition (clouding, cracks, or internal wear not fully inspectable).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the clear bowl/cover from multiple angles under light, plus a quick wipe test showing no cracks/leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially worn/possibly damaged clear cover.

risks.risk: Electrical safety/voltage compatibility (power rating/plate not shown; cord condition unknown).
risks.proof: Close-up of the rating plate/label (voltage, wattage) and a photo of the entire power cord including plug end; ideally a plug-in test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown electrical specs (worst-case: needs replacement/repair).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the rating plate/serial/model number (not just the top “EQUATOR 2” label).
Provide a short video of the appliance running (show power on, operation, and any speed/controls).
Show all included accessories/attachments laid out and counted (including any blades, lids, cups/jars, filters).
Provide close-up photos of the clear bowl/cover for cracks/clouding and the black rim area.
Show the full power cord and plug end, plus confirm voltage compatibility for Oyo (Nigeria).
response.reason: The witness photos identify a countertop appliance labeled “EQUATOR 2,” which contradicts the seller’s claim of a hair dryer. Without proof of the exact item, accessories, and working condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the photos alone.
